text:
Maya: hey all, new hire day 2. trying to run a quick lambda deployment in aws eu-west-1 but the deploy fails with AccessDenied on the role. i attached the team-dev billing/usage but iam seems blocked. any pointers?
Cloud Onboarding Bot: Welcome Maya! Common issues: missing role trust policy or org SCP blocking the region. Share the error and the account id.
Maya: error: 
ERROR: AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/maya is not authorized to assume role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-deploy-role
Account: 123456789012
Maya: i see an SCP in the org that restricts certain actions, not sure who to ping.
DevOps - Priya: hey Maya, we're rolling out a tighter SCP for cross-account role assumption. quick check: does the role have a trust relationship with your user or your identity provider? run `aws iam get-role --role-name ci-deploy-role` and look for Principal entries.
Maya: trust has "Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com" only. so it won't allow sts:AssumeRole from users.
Liam (infra): that's likely it. For short-term access, we can create a delegate role that your user can assume. I can add `sts:AssumeRole` for user/maya on a role named dev-temp-assume for 3 days. Need your manager approval message in the ticket.
Onboard Helper: To request temporary role: https://redwood.internal/access/temporary-roles. Please include account id, role name, and duration.
Maya: pinging my manager for approval now. is there any region restriction for deploying lambdas in eu-west-1 I should know?
Nora (security): FYI we block data residency sensitive regions for prod. eu-west-1 is allowed for non-prod. make sure environment var SECRET_STORE points to workspace secrets, not project secrets.
DevOps - Priya: created role dev-temp-assume and added `sts:AssumeRole` for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/maya. Ticket #ACC-2024-159. Duration 72h.
Maya: tried assume-role flow and deploy now works. thanks Priya!
Maya: small note for onboarding docs: add common assume-role debug steps (get-role, check trust policy, confirm SCP).
